tasks.short: Provide pre-operative and post-operative care for eye-surgery patients.

steps.what: Assess the patients actual pre-operative eye condition and clinical context
inputs: existing surgical plan and clinical history

steps.what: Provide the clinically indicated pre-operative care and explain the patients next steps
inputs: existing surgical plan and clinical history
outputs: actual pre-operative care and counselling outcomes

steps.what: Write actual pre-operative findings, care provided and patient understanding
inputs: actual pre-operative care and counselling outcomes

steps.what: Check and approve the complete actual pre-operative care note
Commit the approved final pre-operative care note
Examine the patients actual post-operative condition after the surgery
inputs: actual surgical record and prior care note

steps.what: Provide indicated post-operative care and explain actual follow-up and escalation needs
inputs: actual surgical record and prior care note
outputs: actual post-operative care and counselling outcomes

steps.what: Write actual post-operative findings using native exact patient and procedure context fields
inputs: actual post-operative care and counselling outcomes
actual surgical record and prior care note

steps.what: Check and approve the complete actual post-operative care note
Commit the approved final post-operative care note

tasks.design: Configure native eye-care record templates and approved-save controls ({OTHER}). Keep pre-operative and post-operative assessment/care/counselling fully human and in their actual lifecycle order. Post-operative context reuse copies only existing patient/procedure fields; actual findings and care are separately written and checked before each notes own commit, without model diagnosis or clinical recommendations.
tasks.previous_blocker: A planned operation does not establish actual post-operative findings or care.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing surgical context can populate exact record fields without repeating clerical entry.
tasks.still_hard: Examination, clinical change and patient understanding require direct care.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise an actual recovery problem and adapt the care or escalation promptly.
tasks.altitude: Small context-copy and posting savings; unchanged eye care.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native clinical-record templates can reuse exact existing patient/procedure context while the clinician records actual findings and care.

assumptions: Shares are provisional, covering both actual visits and focal optometrist labour only. Observe actual repeated context entry and save actions; existing native templates earn no new benefit. Surgery and other clinicians labour are not savings.

Existing clinical/surgical record owners supply patient_id, procedure_id, actual procedure_date, laterality and source_version. s1/s6 clinician verifies context; missing or mismatched context is resolved manually. No surgery result is inferred from its plan.

Optometrist produces actual findings/care in s1/s2 and s6/s7, then separately captures them in s3/s8. s8 retains 7 hours per provisional 100 for all substantive clinical writing and context verification; only repeated exact context entry is reduced. No symptom interpretation, treatment or counselling is automated.

s4/s9 approve their complete actual notes before a1/a2 bind the respective versions; edits revoke approval. Native clinical features precede code. No patient instruction send or clinical order is silently issued.
research_questions: Which patient/procedure fields are still re-entered after current native eye-care record templates?

incremental.description: Check patient/procedure context and note-version mappings

approvals.approved_version: s4 complete actual pre-operative care note
s9 complete actual post-operative care note

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central saves 3 repeated post-operative context-entry and 4 note-commit hours minus 1 upkeep = 6. Low halves context-entry benefit and keeps commits manual: 1.5 minus 1 = 0.5. All clinical care unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Consult other practitioners and refer patients needing additional medical treatment.

steps.what: Assess the patients actual findings and decide whether specialist medical care is needed
inputs: actual patient findings and existing clinical records
outputs: human referral decision and clinical rationale

steps.what: Capture the actual referral reason, findings, urgency and chosen practitioner
inputs: human referral decision and clinical rationale
actual patient findings and existing clinical records

steps.what: Discuss the actual referral purpose and next steps with the patient
Draft and correct the referral letter from the clinicians checked factual note

loop.purpose: Draft referral prose expressing the clinicians already-made referral decision
loop.input: Checked clinician-authored actual findings, reason, urgency, destination and patient discussion outcome
loop.output: Candidate referral letter with factual statements linked to the checked note
loop.check: Optometrist verifies clinical meaning, laterality, negation, uncertainty, urgency, recipient and that no diagnosis, finding or requested treatment was added or omitted
loop.stop: Missing evidence, changed clinical meaning or two failed corrections returns the letter to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Native templates fill fixed identity fields but varied clinical narrative needs paraphrasing; use the loop only where substantive letter drafting remains

steps.what: Approve the exact final referral letter, attachments and actual specialist recipient
Send the approved final referral package through the authorised clinical exchange
Consult the practitioner about actual patient findings and needed specialist care
Write and approve actual consultation advice, referral status and next actions
Commit the approved actual referral consultation record

tasks.design: Use the existing clinical record/referral exchange ({OTHER}) and native letter template first. Where narrative drafting remains, a bounded model drafts only from the optometrists checked decision note, with clinical meaning and omissions checked before final package approval and separate send. Actual practitioner consultation stays human; its actual outcome is separately written/approved before commit.
tasks.previous_blocker: A referral letter must preserve the clinicians actual reason, uncertainty and urgency.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-bound drafting can reduce prose assembly without making the referral decision.
tasks.still_hard: Clinical need, specialist choice and consultation require practitioner judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Explain the concern accurately enough for the receiving practitioner to act appropriately.
tasks.altitude: Less referral prose/transfer work with unchanged clinical decisions.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: bounded referral drafting can express clinician-authored facts for clinical correction before approved exchange; it does not establish diagnosis or urgency.

assumptions: Shares are provisional. Establish actual residual narrative work after native templates; current clinical exchange/runtime earns no new saving. No general vendor timing is used as a local baseline.

Optometrist produces the actual decision in s1 and captures patient_id, findings, laterality, referral_reason, clinician-set urgency, chosen_practitioner and source_refs in s2 at full time. Existing record owners supply prior clinical results. Missing facts are manually clarified, never inferred by the draft.

s4 retains 13 hours per provisional 100 for complete semantic correction, including omitted material and clinical qualification. Pilot checks must support that retained effort; otherwise lower benefit/use manual drafting. s5 checks the actual completed letter/attachments and destination before a1; edits revoke approval.

Receiving practitioner supplies actual consultation response after send. s8 separately writes/checks actual advice/status/next action before a2. This is the written-referral-then-consultation route; urgent live contact retains actual full time and is not delayed by drafting. No automated medical decision.
research_questions: After native templates, can source-bound drafting preserve every clinically material qualification with less total clinician time?

already_counted.description: Clinical meaning and omission correction of the referral draft

incremental.description: Sample referral omissions and maintain source/destination mappings

approvals.approved_version: s5 complete final referral package and specialist recipient

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central saves 7 drafting, 5 referral-transfer and 2 record-post hours minus 2 upkeep = 12. Low halves drafting benefit and keeps transfers manual: 3.5 minus 2 = 1.5. Clinical assessment and consultation unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prescribe therapeutic procedures to correct or conserve vision.

steps.what: Assess the actual patients visual condition, findings and relevant clinical history
Choose and prescribe the therapeutic procedure within actual clinical authority
Explain the procedure, expected limits and follow-up to the patient
Write the therapeutic prescription using native exact patient and encounter fields
inputs: existing verified patient and encounter fields

steps.what: Approve the exact final prescription, clinical meaning and patient delivery destination
Commit the approved final therapeutic procedure prescription to the clinical record
Send the approved final therapeutic procedure prescription to the patient

tasks.design: Use native clinical order forms and approved delivery controls ({OTHER}) for exact patient/encounter context. Keep examination, therapeutic procedure selection, counselling and all substantive prescription instructions human. Approve the complete final prescription before separate clinical-record commit and patient send; no model selects a procedure or generates clinical parameters.
tasks.previous_blocker: A form cannot decide which therapeutic procedure is indicated for the actual patient.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing clinical forms can reuse exact identity/context and transfer an approved prescription.
tasks.still_hard: Clinical suitability, patient understanding and follow-up remain practitioner work.
tasks.human_edge: Adjust the therapeutic plan to actual findings and the patients ability to follow it.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated context entry and transfer; unchanged prescribing rights.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native clinical order forms can reuse exact patient/encounter fields and deliver an approved prescription without choosing clinical treatment.

assumptions: Shares are provisional for an optometrist acting within the actual local clinical scope. Establish actual duplicate context entry and transfer; existing native forms earn no new benefit. This is no jurisdiction-specific statement about prescribing powers.

Optometrist produces the actual clinical decision and patient discussion in s1/s2/s3. Existing registration records supply patient_id, encounter_id and verified contact. s4 retains 12 hours per provisional 100 for capturing actual procedure, laterality, clinician-authored instructions, follow-up and corrections; only repeated identity/context entry is reduced. Missing facts stay manual.

s5 checks complete prescription meaning, authority, patient linkage and recipient before a1/a2 bind final versions and their separate destinations. Changed instructions revoke both approvals. Native form controls precede code.
No physical procedure, medication order, diagnosis or follow-up outcome is inferred or silently performed by the system. Clinical assessment and counselling retain full labour.
research_questions: Which clerical fields are re-entered after the existing clinical order form has the verified patient context?

approvals.approved_version: s5 exact final therapeutic prescription and clinical-record destination
s5 exact final therapeutic prescription and patient recipient

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central saves 3 repeated context-entry, 3 commit and 2 patient-transfer hours minus 1 upkeep = 7. Low halves context-entry benefit and keeps transfers manual: 1.5 minus 1 = 0.5. Clinical choice and counselling unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retain clinical eye-care decisions while native records and checked drafting support documentation.
reach: Help receiving practitioners distinguish actual findings, clinician decisions and actual consultation outcomes.
role.ambitious_version: An optometrist who keeps attention on examination and patient understanding while accurate, approved records reach the right destination.
